notes.title: Release Date Announcement | Final Demo
notes.content:
[h3]Look Alive, Sailors! The Wait Ends Soon![/h3]

Lock and load, because Captain Wayne is locked on target and headed straight for Boomstock – the blood-pumping, retro-blasting, boomer-shooter showdown where weak gamers go to die.

This Tuesday, September 23rd at 19:00 CEST (10am PST), the Captain’s bringing heat:

- A brand-new trailer with fresh cuts of gameplay and animation

- The final demo update, with an additional level to unleash hell upon

-And finally, the big one: the official release date for Captain Wayne: Vacation Desperation.

So strap in, stock up, and get ready to set sail and wishlist.

[u][b]Because Captain Wayne sets sail November 25th[/b][/u]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2319790/Captain_Wayne__Vacation_Desperation/

Watch the trailer  here;[/b]

notes.title: Endless Demo Update - Available NOW
notes.content:
Raise anchor, load your boom brews, and keep your arms inside the bloodbath at all times.

As part of Yogscast's Tiny Teams Captain Wayne is anything but tiny, bringing you unlimited carnage in this demo update!

[previewyoutube=mSi4NNxe9QY;full][/previewyoutube]

Endless Mode brings 6 playable maps into the mix, 3 unlocked from the get-go, and 3 more waiting to be earned through carnage, grit, or sheer dumb luck. 

As always, Wishlist Captain Wayne [b]NOW[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/search/?developer=Ciaran%20Games%20LLC

If you experience any bugs, please report them to our Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/CaptainWayne"]https://discord.gg/CaptainWayne[/url]

notes.title: ENDLESS MODE - v1.1
notes.content:
1.1 changelog:
-Fixed the issue with the special waves that involve special EARL death messages not properly triggering in Emivita due to an extra EARL located in the camera room. Now EARK is there.
-Fixed the issue with the Wayne's Keys menu not pointing at the correct Kick and Last Weapon keybinds.
-Added menu dim by default to address menu readability issues.
-Made the game start in fullscreen by default.
-Made the HUD not stretch out vertically by default (it was adjusting to the aspect ratio.)
-Made OpenGL the default hardware renderer backend.
-Updated Automap colors.
-Made Boom Brew's physical radius and height smaller, hopefully fixing the issue with dynamites being stuck in ceilings.
-Fixed the issue with Boom Brew triggering an explosion twice at once when exploding on a non direct impact.
-Added unique win messages for the endless maps.
-Fixed the issue with some of the enemies not initializing their deaths properly, which lead to their corpses being blockable.
-Fixed the issue with Sunken Smasher in Beached Beluga Blues not noticing you right away when blasting through the door on his first encounter.
-Added Miscellaneous tab.
-Added a warning prompt to the Engine Options option.
-Updated the menu visually.
-Fixed the issue with the projectiles breaking the endless mode map endings.
-Polished up some of the endings.
-Fixed the issue with dynamite spawning blood decals (what the hell).
-Updated old crosshairs and added new ones.
-Moved some settings from visual options to game options.
